home.hero_heading: Gentle care for skin that glows
home.hero_text: Short formulas, soft textures and rituals that fit your day. Made with care, kind to your skin.
home.story_heading: Beauty that feels like a pause
home.story_text: We make small-batch formulas with ingredients we can name, in recyclable packaging. Every product is tested on people, never on animals.
home.faq_1_q: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
home.faq_1_a: Yes. Our formulas are fragrance free and dermatologically tested. Do a patch test if you are unsure.
home.faq_2_q: How fast will I see results?
home.faq_2_a: Most people notice more comfort in a week and a visible glow after 4 weeks of daily use.
home.faq_3_q: Can I return an opened product?
home.faq_3_a: Unopened products can be returned within 30 days. If a product does not suit you, contact us and we will find a solution.
home.newsletter_text: Rituals, early access and 10% off your first order.
